# Routes a mode that federates adds to those of its mode (testdata/routes-local.txt, and
# testdata/routes-single.txt in single mode with FLOWA_FEDERATE=on): discovery, docs/federation.md 5.3 and
# 5.4; the actors, the public pages and their pictures, 5.5, 5.6, 6.5 and 9.4; a post's Create, the
# outboxes and the collections, 6.2 and 6.4; the search by handle a member makes, 5.3 and 11; the
# federation page of the admin area with the domain policies, section 10 and FMD 1; the inboxes, section 7
# and FWR 1.
# TestDBFederatedRoutes holds the table to it.
